notes.title: Aye aye! One more update!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome, Pirates!🏴‍☠️ Arrrrr-you ready?[/b] 🦜

We've prepared for you some surprises... [b]Let us know if you liked the new update![/b] ⛵
[b]Thank y'all for all[/b] of your comments, opinions, reviews and thoughts.
[u][b]Each and every of your feedbacks counts and helps us improve the game! [/b][/u]💪
Here's what has changed since our last meeting...

[list][*] Issues with saving and[b] loading cutscenes [/b]have been fixed.
[*] [b]Dialogues [/b]during cutscenes [b]are displayed correctly.[/b]
[*] Cutscene skipping [b]should now properly skip [/b]the cutscene.
[*] Several [b]instances of crashes[/b] and game [b]freezes [/b]have been fixed.
[*] Minor[b] adjustments and improvements[/b] to cutscenes have been made.
[*] [b]Translations have been updated and improved[/b], including character [b]encoding [/b]and text [b]display[/b].
[*] Enemies [b]can now be stunned[/b] while playing the drum.
[*] It is now possible to [b]switch characters[/b] while queuing to drop a body with another character.
[*] Minor fixes have been made to[b] UI display and functionality.[/b]
[*] Saving the used Aztec [b]trap now functions correctly.[/b]
[*] Some [b]character animations and glitches[/b] have been fixed.
[*] [b]Navigation [/b]fixes have been implemented for the [b]Pirate Island and the Temple.[/b]
[*] If a character was [b]crouching [/b]before picking up a body, they will still crouch after dropping it.
[*] Level c[b]ompletion requirements are working correctly[/b] (no alarm, correct number of characters).
[*] Double characters during certain cutscenes [b]have been resolved.[/b]
[*] The character is[b] properly detected [/b]in the far area while carrying a body.
[*] Used healing items[b] will no longer replenish[/b] after loading the game.
[*] The camera [b]can no longer go beyond the boundaries[/b] of the map.[/list]
Sea ya!

[i]Frigato Team[/i]

Ps. For only three more days Frigato is -15% OFF! Don't miss your chance!

notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42457113/bd899ab907d915ec5bd76d01b4fcf7cf55a1ebf6.png[/img]

We have launched the game but as we wrote before we are still here working on the game. Here is the first patch. Don't worry, more will follow shortly.

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Many instances of crashes and errors in the game have been fixed.
[*] Fixed the auto-play of cutscenes after loading the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed transitioning between levels.
[*] Improved and refined tutorials.
[*] Corrected skill descriptions.
[*] Camera improvement in level 3.
[*] Brazilian Portuguese language has been added.
[*] Some corrections were made in translations to various languages.
[*] Fixed screen flickering when clicking on New Game.
[*] Fixed duplicate characters after a cutscene.
[*] Improved the UI in the main menu for different resolutions.
[*] The enemy does not detect immediately after the first cutscene.
[/list]

Thank you and have fun
Frigato team.
